show.description: Bad**s Bodyguard follows Arya Dixit, a strong-willed billionaire CEO who rebels against her manipulative family’s plan to marry her off for money, only to find unexpected love and protection in her bodyguard, Neel. Their relationship sparks a storm of betrayal, power struggles, and hidden truths as love collides with greed and deception.
